# TRIDENT provenance

Unmodified CPU training and model sources from
[Stellarproximology Lab at dd31be0](https://github.com/justappgrabbin/Stellarproximology-lab/tree/dd31be007da9829df74460a82331aecf8634a1df).
The POP wrapper supplies design constraints, corpus provenance, evaluation and
activation records. TRIDENT's existing code, math and research heads are part of
the shared model. Weights and training records live in the operator's workspace.
